## CUTANEOUS CANDIDIASIS
## Inpatient

Cutaneous candidiasis is a superficial fungal infection of the epidermis.
Presents with red, erythematous patches, often in areas where skin contacts
skin, including axillae, groin, and abdominal folds.
Keep affected areas dry and clean.
## Treatment
Treat for 4 weeks.
## Inpatient

Clotrimazole 1% cream apply to affected area BID ($) [M]
## Alternative
Nystatin Cream to affected area BID ($) [M]
## Outpatient

Clotrimazole 1% cream apply to affected area BID ($) [M]
Non-VA order for above
## Alternative
Nystatin Cream to affected area BID ($) [M]
Non-VA order for above
